title: Putnami Workload Types
description: Defines the workload classifications for Putnami projects. A workload type describes the runtime behavior and lifecycle expectations of a project.

x-descriptions.service: Long-running process that serves requests (HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket). Lifecycle: start → ready → serve → stop. Supports health checks, graceful shutdown, and readiness probes.
x-descriptions.worker: Long-running background processor that consumes work from a source (queue, stream, file system). Lifecycle: start → process → stop. Runs indefinitely until signaled to stop.
x-descriptions.job: One-shot batch execution that runs to completion. Lifecycle: start → execute → complete. Used for migrations, data imports, builds, and scheduled tasks.
x-descriptions.command: Interactive CLI one-shot that executes and exits. Lifecycle: execute → exit. Used for code generators, formatters, and developer tools.

WorkloadDescriptor.description: Full workload descriptor declaring type and runtime properties.

runsWith.description: Service dependencies that must be running alongside this workload (e.g., database, cache).

HealthCheck.description: Health check configuration for service and worker workloads.

path.description: HTTP path for health check endpoint (services only).

intervalMs.description: Interval between health checks in milliseconds.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single health check in milliseconds.

GracefulShutdown.description: Graceful shutdown configuration for long-running workloads.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for graceful shutdown in milliseconds.

signal.description: Signal to send for graceful shutdown.
